EPF_REGISTRATION.title: KWSP (EPF) employer registration
EPF_REGISTRATION.why: Needed before you can pay EPF contributions for your staff.

SOCSO_REGISTRATION.title: PERKESO (SOCSO and EIS) employer registration
SOCSO_REGISTRATION.why: Covers staff for work injuries, invalidity and job loss (EIS).

LHDN_E_NUMBER.title: LHDN employer E-number
LHDN_E_NUMBER.why: Needed to send monthly tax deductions (PCB) to LHDN from the first payroll.

PAYROLL_BANK_ACCOUNT.title: Company bank account for payroll
PAYROLL_BANK_ACCOUNT.why: A corporate account with bulk payments, so salaries can be paid from a payment file. Leaves a week to test the first file.

PDPA_PRIVACY_NOTICE.title: PDPA privacy notice published
PDPA_PRIVACY_NOTICE.why: Staff and candidates must be told, in BM and English, how their personal data is used.

DPO_APPOINTED.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO) appointed
DPO_APPOINTED.why: Name the person responsible for protecting personal data. Set your own due date.

HRDCORP_REGISTRATION.title: HRD Corp employer registration
HRDCORP_REGISTRATION.why: Optional under 10 Malaysian staff, required from 10. Leave as not applicable until then.

hr_admin.name: HR Admin
hr_admin.description: Manages staff, leave, claims and credential checks, and prepares payroll.

manager.name: Manager / Clinical Lead
manager.description: Approves their team's leave, overtime and claims, and sees the team's credential status.

staff.name: Staff
staff.description: Self-service: own profile, leave, claims, clock-in, payslips and credentials.

auditor.name: Auditor (read-only)
auditor.description: Reads records and reports but can't change anything. For your accountant or an inspection.
